content.text:
**Finding: deviation (§ 12.1 License, p0149)**

The Base Components grant is "nonexclusive, revocable" and runs to Customer only — IBM can pull the licence at will, and our Affiliates and contractors are excluded with no path to add them. That is the rule's walk-away fact pattern, so it fails even the fallback. § 14.17 ("only the licenses expressly specified") confirms there is no implied cure; § 14.10 already permits assignment to a successor by merger, consolidation or acquisition, so the successor-transfer element needs no change.

Redline (validated, preferred position): extends the grant to "its Affiliates and contractors acting on Customer's behalf", deletes "revocable", and provides that the licence is irrevocable except on expiration or termination under Section 3, with Affiliate-coverage-on-notice offered as a fallback in the comment.
